question: Identify all roles that are compliant and list the resources they grant access to, including the type of each resource.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = true RETURN r.name, res.name, res.type

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which in turn grant access to resources, and return the policy name, role name, and resource name for each path.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: List all users who have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and have been granted temporary access to any resource, showing their names and department.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.department

question: Retrieve all groups created by users in the 'IT' department along with the number of members in each group, sorted by member count in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN g.name, g.member_count ORDER BY g.member_count ASC

question: Identify all roles that grant access to more than 5 resources and are compliant. Return the role name and the count of resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = true RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN r.name, resource_count

question: Show policies that enforce roles which in turn grant access to resources of type 'Database', listing policy names and descriptions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription

question: List all users who have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and have been granted temporary access to any resource, including details of the temporary access reason and expiration time.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res:Resource) RETURN u.User_id, u.name, ta.reason, ta.expires_at

question: Retrieve the names of users who have roles granting access to more than 5 resources, along with the total number of such resources per user.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN u.name, resource_count

question: List all User nodes who have attempted access to resources with sensitivity level 'Confidential' and have been granted temporary access to any resource, showing their name, email, and department.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.email, u.department

question: Identify all Role nodes that are compliant and are enforced by at least one Policy which has a review status of 'Approved', returning the role names and descriptions.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'}) RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: List all users who have temporary access to resources that are marked as 'Confidential' sensitivity level, including details of the temporary access and the resource name.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u.name, t.reason, t.granted_at, t.expires_at, r.name

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database', and return the policy name, role name, and resource name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: List all users who have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and have been granted temporary access for the same resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r) RETURN DISTINCT u.name, r.name

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than 5 resources, and return the policy names along with the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name, resource_count

question: Identify groups that contain users from the 'Engineering' department and also count how many such users are in each group.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'Engineering' RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(u) AS EngineeringUserCount

question: List all users who have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and have been granted temporary access to any resource, showing their names and the reason for temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS UserName, ta.reason AS ReasonForAccess

question: Find groups that contain users who have roles marked as non-compliant and list the group names along with the number of such users in each group.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(u) AS NonCompliantUserCount

question: Show the average number of members in groups created by users who have at least one role granting them access to more than five resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT MATCH (g:Group) WHERE g.created_by = u RETURN AVG(g.member_count) AS AverageMembersInGroups

question: Return the names of policies that enforce roles which in turn grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and have a review status of 'Approved'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'API Endpoint' AND p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Identify all roles that are compliant and are enforced by at least one policy, returning the role names along with the count of policies enforcing each role.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r.name, COUNT(p) AS policy_count

question: Return the names and email addresses of users who have never attempted access to any resource.
gql: MATCH (u:User) WHERE NOT EXISTS((u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)) RETURN u.name, u.email

question: Identify all roles which grant access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and count how many such resources each role has access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN r.name AS RoleName, COUNT(res) AS ConfidentialResourceCount

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential', including the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription

question: Count the number of temporary accesses granted per user, displaying only those users who have more than two temporary accesses, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u, COUNT(ta) AS TempAccessCount NEXT RETURN u.name AS UserName, TempAccessCount ORDER BY TempAccessCount DESC

question: Identify users who have both permanent roles granting access to sensitive resources (sensitivity level 'Confidential') and at least one temporary access to any resource, returning their names, email addresses, and the total count of their temporary accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(role:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u.name, u.email, COUNT(ta) AS TempAccessCount

question: List the names of resources that are targeted by access events originating from users in the 'Marketing' department, ensuring each resource is listed only once.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Marketing' RETURN DISTINCT r.name

question: Retrieve the top 5 users with the highest number of distinct roles assigned, along with the count of those roles and the departments they belong to.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS RoleCount NEXT RETURN u.name, u.department, RoleCount ORDER BY RoleCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Public' and have been reviewed with a status of 'Approved'. Return the policy name, description, and the number of such roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Public' AND p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN p.name, p.description, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS RoleCount

question: Identify users who have both permanent and temporary access to the same resource. Return the user name, resource name, and the reason for temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r) RETURN u.name, r.name, ta.reason

question: For each department, calculate the average number of resources accessed per user, considering only users who have accessed at least one resource. Order the results by the average in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS userId, COUNT(r.Resource_id) AS resourceCount NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(resourceCount) AS avgResourcesPerUser ORDER BY avgResourcesPerUser DESC NEXT RETURN dept, avgResourcesPerUser

question: Retrieve the names of roles enforced by policies that have a review status of 'Pending', along with the number of resources each role grants access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS ResourceCount

question: List all groups and the number of compliant roles associated with users in those groups, sorted by the number of compliant roles in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true}) RETURN g.name, COUNT(r) AS compliant_role_count ORDER BY compliant_role_count DESC

question: Retrieve policies that enforce roles granting access to resources created after January 1, 2023, and include the policy name, role name, and resource name where the resource type is 'Application'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date > date('2023-01-01') AND res.type = 'Application' RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: Determine the average number of resources accessed per user for users who have accessed more than 3 resources, grouped by their role type.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN r.role_type, AVG(resource_count) AS avg_resources_accessed

question: Find all users who belong to groups created by users from the 'IT' department and list their names along with the group names, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (it_user:User{department:'IT'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT g NEXT MATCH (g)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS UserName, g.name AS GroupName

question: Show the names of roles that are compliant and are associated with users who belong to groups with more than 5 members, along with the group names and member counts.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group) WHERE g.member_count > 5 RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS RoleName, g.name AS GroupName, g.member_count AS MemberCount

question: Retrieve the top 5 roles with the highest number of associated policies, along with the count of policies for each role.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r.name AS RoleName, COUNT(p) AS PolicyCount ORDER BY PolicyCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Determine the average number of resources accessed per user for users who have attempted access more than 5 times. Show the user's name and the average count of accessed resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts, COUNT(r) AS distinct_resources NEXT RETURN u.name, AVG(distinct_resources) AS avg_accessed_resources

question: List policies that enforce roles granting access to both 'Database' and 'File Server' type resources, showing the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res1:Resource) WHERE res1.type = 'Database' RETURN p, r NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res2:Resource) WHERE res2.type = 'File Server' RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription

question: Retrieve a list of policies that enforce roles which grant access to 'Database' type resources, including the policy name, role name, and resource name, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS PolicyName, r.name AS RoleName, res.name AS ResourceName

question: For each department, calculate the average number of temporary accesses granted to users, considering only those users who have at least one temporary access, and display the department names along with the calculated average.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u.department AS Department, u.User_id AS UserID, COUNT(ta) AS TempAccessCount NEXT RETURN Department, AVG(TempAccessCount) AS AvgTempAccesses NEXT RETURN Department, AvgTempAccesses

question: For each policy, find the number of distinct roles it enforces and the total number of resources those roles grant access to. Only include policies enforcing more than 2 roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, COUNT(r) AS role_count, COUNT(res) AS total_resources NEXT RETURN p.name, role_count, total_resources

question: Identify users who have accessed resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' more than once and also hold roles that grant them access to those resources directly.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u, r, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:HasRole]->(ro:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r) RETURN DISTINCT u.name, r.name, access_count

question: Retrieve all policies that enforce roles which have been assigned to users in the 'IT' department and list the policy name, role name, and user name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, r.name AS RoleName, u.name AS UserName

question: Find the average number of temporary accesses granted per user for resources categorized as 'High' sensitivity, excluding users who have never had any temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'High' RETURN u, COUNT(ta) AS temp_access_count NEXT RETURN AVG(temp_access_count) AS AverageTempAccessesPerUser

question: Find users who have been granted temporary access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and return their names along with the reason for temporary access and the resource name.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u.name, t.reason, r.name

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce at least one role which grants access to more than 3 resources, along with the number of such roles per policy.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS role_count

question: Retrieve the names of users who belong to groups with more than 10 members and have roles that grant access to at least one resource with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential'. Include the group name and the count of confidential resources they can access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u, g NEXT MATCH (u)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u, g, COUNT(res) AS confidential_resource_count NEXT RETURN u.name, g.name, confidential_resource_count

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and were reviewed after January 1, 2023. Include the policy name and its review status.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' AND p.effective_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.review_status AS ReviewStatus

question: Determine the most frequently accessed confidential resource by users in the 'Finance' department and return the resource name along with the count of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Finance' AND r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, COUNT(ae) AS AccessCount ORDER BY AccessCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than two different types of resources. Also include the policy description and the number of distinct resource types involved.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res.type) AS distinct_resource_types NEXT RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS Description, distinct_resource_types AS ResourceTypeCount

question: List all users who have been granted temporary access to resources, including the resource name, the reason for access, and the expiration date of the temporary access, sorted by the expiration date.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u.name AS UserName, r.name AS ResourceName, ta.reason AS Reason, ta.expires_at AS ExpiresAt ORDER BY ta.expires_at

question: Which roles are associated with users who have accessed more than 5 distinct resources? Provide the role name and the count of distinct resources accessed by users having that role.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS distinct_resources NEXT RETURN r.name AS RoleName, distinct_resources AS DistinctResourcesCount

question: List all policies which enforce roles that grant access to more than 5 resources. Include the policy name, role name, and the count of resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name, r.name, resource_count

question: Determine the top 3 departments based on the highest total number of access attempts by their users. Return the department name and the total access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE u.department IS NOT NULL RETURN u.department, COUNT(ae) AS total_attempts ORDER BY total_attempts DESC LIMIT 3

question: List groups that contain users from at least three different departments, showing the group name and the count of distinct departments represented within each group.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) RETURN g, COUNT(u.department) AS dept_count NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, dept_count AS DepartmentCount

question: For each role, calculate the average number of policies it enforces across all roles, and return the role name along with this average, ordered by the highest average first.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT RETURN r.name AS RoleName, AVG(policy_count) AS AvgPoliciesEnforced ORDER BY AvgPoliciesEnforced DESC

question: Retrieve audit logs for actions performed by users who have accessed more than three different resources. Show the log timestamp, action, and the user's name.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS resource_count NEXT MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN al.timestamp, al.action, u.name

question: List all users who have accessed resources that are not compliant with their assigned roles, including the resource name, role name, and access timestamp.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, r, res NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res) RETURN u.name, res.name, r.name, ae.timestamp

question: List all groups and for each group, find the number of compliant roles associated with its members, only including groups where this count exceeds 2.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true}) RETURN g, COUNT(r) AS compliant_role_count NEXT RETURN g.name, compliant_role_count

question: Retrieve the names of users who have roles that grant access to more than 3 resources and are part of groups with more than 10 members. Also, return the count of such resources per user.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS ResourceCount NEXT MATCH (u)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u.name, ResourceCount

question: Find users who have both permanent and temporary access to the same resource, displaying their user ID, the resource name, and the reason for temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) RETURN u.User_id, res.name, ta.reason

question: List the top 5 most frequently accessed resources by users in the 'Engineering' department, showing the resource name, type, and the count of access events, ordered by the access count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Engineering'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN res.name, res.type, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of users who have been granted temporary access to more than two resources with different sensitivity levels, along with the count of distinct sensitivity levels they have accessed.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(r.sensitivity_level) AS sensitivity_levels_count NEXT RETURN u.name, sensitivity_levels_count

question: Find users who have roles granting access to at least one 'Database' and one 'API Endpoint' type resource, and who also belong to a group with a member count greater than 20. Return the user's name, role name, and group name.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res1:Resource) WHERE res1.type = 'Database' RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res2:Resource) WHERE res2.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group) WHERE g.member_count > 20 RETURN u.name, r.name, g.name

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint', ensuring no duplicates in the results.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Identify users who have been granted temporary access to more than two resources and list their names along with the total number of temporary accesses, sorted in descending order by the count.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(ta) AS temp_access_count NEXT RETURN u.name AS UserName, temp_access_count ORDER BY temp_access_count DESC

question: List the top 5 most active users based on the number of access events they've attempted, including their name and the count of access attempts, considering only successful outcomes.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN u.name AS UserName, COUNT(ae) AS AccessAttempts ORDER BY AccessAttempts DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of groups and the average number of members in each group, excluding groups with less than 5 members.
gql: MATCH (g:Group) WHERE g.member_count >= 5 RETURN g.name AS GroupName, AVG(g.member_count) AS AverageMembers

question: List all groups and the number of distinct roles held by users in each group, only including groups where users hold more than 2 distinct roles.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN g, COUNT(r) AS role_count NEXT RETURN g.name, role_count

question: Find the top 3 most accessed resources by users with the role type 'Admin', including the resource name and the number of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {role_type: 'Admin'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(*) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: For each policy that has been reviewed with a status of 'Pending', find the roles it enforces and the resources those roles grant access to, returning the policy name, role name, resource name, and resource sensitivity level, ordered by policy name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, r.name AS RoleName, res.name AS ResourceName, res.sensitivity_level AS SensitivityLevel ORDER BY PolicyName

question: List all groups that have users belonging to roles which are not compliant and provide the group name, description, and the count of non-compliant roles associated with each group.
gql: MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN g, COUNT(r) AS non_compliant_roles NEXT RETURN g.name, g.description, non_compliant_roles

question: Retrieve the names of users who have been granted temporary access to more than one resource and the total number of such temporary accesses, including the earliest and latest grant times.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(t) AS temp_access_count, MIN(t.granted_at) AS first_grant, MAX(t.granted_at) AS last_grant NEXT RETURN u.name, temp_access_count, first_grant, last_grant

question: Find two-hop paths starting and ending at Policy nodes (where the start Policy_id='P00009' and the end Policy_id≠'P00009'), connected through any relationship in the middle; also find three-hop paths with the same start and end conditions. Merge the results of both cases and return them, with a maximum of 5 records for each.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Policy)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:Policy) WHERE n1.Policy_id = "P00009" AND n2.Policy_id <> "P00009" RETURN p LIMIT 5 UNION ALL MATCH p = (n1:Policy)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(y)-[e3]-(n2:Policy) WHERE n1.Policy_id = "P00009" AND n2.Policy_id <> "P00009" RETURN p LIMIT 5

question: Find the Policy nodes connected to resource 'R000001' and return the count of these policies.
gql: MATCH (n1:Policy)-[]->(n2:Resource) WHERE n2.Resource_id = "R000001" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n1) as count_alias

question: Find all paths connected by GrantAccessTo edges linking policies and resources, where the starting Policy name is 'Compliance Policy 9' and the target Resource is not with sensitivity level 'Public', including both two-hop and three-hop paths with merged results.

question: Identify all users who have roles that grant access to at least five resources of type 'Database' and list their names along with the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS db_count NEXT FILTER db_count >= 5 RETURN u.name, db_count

question: List all roles that are compliant and grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint', along with the number of policies enforcing each role and the average number of resources per policy associated with those roles.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN r NEXT MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT MATCH (p)-[:Enforces]->(r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, policy_count, p, COUNT(res) AS resources_per_policy NEXT RETURN r.name AS role_name, policy_count, AVG(resources_per_policy) AS avg_resources_per_policy

question: Find policies that enforce roles which in turn grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Return the policy name, role name, and the count of such API endpoints per role-policy pair.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(ro:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(re:Resource) WHERE re.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN p.name AS policy_name, ro.name AS role_name, COUNT(re) AS api_endpoint_count

question: Identify users who belong to groups with more than 10 members and have attempted access to resources with an unsuccessful outcome. Return the user names and the group names.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)-[:BelongsTo]-(other:User) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u, g, COUNT(other) AS member_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS UserName, g.name AS GroupName

question: Retrieve the names of roles that are not compliant and are granted by policies that have a review status of 'Pending'. Also, include the permissions list of these roles.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: false})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) WHERE p.review_status = 'Pending' RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.permissions_list AS PermissionsList

question: Find all policies that enforce roles granting access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and also to resources of type 'Database'. Return the policy names and descriptions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res1:Resource) WHERE res1.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN p, r NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res2:Resource) WHERE res2.type = 'Database' RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description

question: List the departments along with the count of users who have roles marked as non-compliant, ordered by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role {is_compliant: false}) RETURN u.department AS department, COUNT(u) AS non_compliant_user_count ORDER BY non_compliant_user_count DESC

question: Identify all policies that enforce at least two roles which in turn grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Return the policy name and the count of such roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN p, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count NEXT FILTER role_count >= 2 RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, role_count AS RoleCount

question: Find all users who have accessed resources with an 'FAILURE' outcome more than twice and list their names along with the resource names and the count of failures, sorted by failure count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' RETURN u, r, COUNT(ae) AS failure_count NEXT FILTER failure_count > 2 RETURN u.name, r.name, failure_count ORDER BY failure_count DESC

question: Identify resources that are targeted by access events from users in the 'IT' department with an outcome of 'SUCCESS', and return the resource name, type, and the count of successful accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'IT'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType, COUNT(ae) AS SuccessCount

question: Identify roles that are compliant and are granted by policies reviewed as 'Approved', and list the number of resources each such role grants access to, but only include roles that grant access to more than 3 resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, count(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN r.name AS role_name, resource_count

question: Retrieve the names of users who have attempted access to resources but the outcome was 'FAILURE', along with the resource name and the IP address used during the attempt, ensuring no duplicates in results.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS user_name, r.name AS resource_name, ae.ip_address AS ip_address

question: Retrieve all policies that have been reviewed (review_status is not 'Pending') and enforce roles that are non-compliant, listing the policy name, review status, and role name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: false}) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.review_status AS review_status, r.name AS role_name UNION MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Rejected'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: false}) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.review_status AS review_status, r.name AS role_name

question: Determine the average number of resources each compliant role grants access to, excluding roles that grant access to less than 3 resources.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 3 RETURN AVG(resource_count) AS average_resources_per_role

question: Which resources have been accessed by users from the 'IT' department through both permanent roles and temporary access? Provide the resource name and the count of distinct users accessing it in both ways.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'IT'})-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) RETURN res.name AS resource_name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than five resources and return the policy name along with the count of such resources, ordered by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: Find roles that are enforced by more than two policies and grant access to at least five resources. Return the role name and the total count of policies enforcing it and resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count > 2 MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, policy_count, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 5 RETURN r.name AS role_name, policy_count, resource_count

question: Retrieve audit logs for actions performed by users who have been granted temporary access to more than two resources. Include the action, details, and the user's name.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 2 MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN al.action AS action, al.details AS details, u.name AS user_name

question: Which policies enforce roles that grant access to resources of type 'Application' and have an effective date after '2024-06-01'? Return the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Application' AND p.effective_date > date('2024-06-01') RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description

question: Find policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and have an effective date after '2024-06-01'. Return the policy name, role name, and resource name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE p.effective_date > date('2024-06-01') AND res.type = 'Database' RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, r.name AS RoleName, res.name AS ResourceName

question: List all groups and the number of users in each group who have roles granting access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Include only groups with more than two such users.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN g, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count NEXT FILTER user_count > 2 RETURN g.name AS group_name, user_count

question: Which departments have users who have accessed more than ten distinct resources, and what is the average number of accesses per user in those departments?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, u.department AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS distinct_resources, COUNT(ae) AS total_accesses NEXT FILTER distinct_resources > 10 RETURN dept, AVG(total_accesses) AS avg_accesses_per_user

question: List all resources that are targeted by access events with an outcome of 'FAILURE' and are also linked to policies that enforce non-compliant roles. Include the resource name and sensitivity level.
gql: MATCH (res:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent)-[:AttemptsAccess]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' AND r.is_compliant = false RETURN DISTINCT res.name AS ResourceName, res.sensitivity_level AS SensitivityLevel

question: List all roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and are granted access to at least three different types of resources, along with the count of resource types they grant access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT res.type) AS resource_types_count NEXT FILTER resource_types_count >= 3 RETURN r.name AS role_name, resource_types_count

question: Identify users who have been granted temporary access to more than one resource, and for each user, list their name, email, and the total number of temporary accesses they have been granted.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(t) AS temp_access_count NEXT FILTER temp_access_count > 1 RETURN u.name AS user_name, u.email AS email, temp_access_count

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than 5 resources, along with the average effective date of these policies.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN p.name, AVG(p.effective_date) AS avg_effective_date

question: List all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and were created after January 1, 2023. Include the policy name, description, and the number of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' AND res.created_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN p.name, p.description, COUNT(res) AS database_resource_count

question: List all roles that are enforced by policies reviewed as 'Pending' and grant access to resources created before '2023-01-01'. Include the role name and the number of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date < DATE('2023-01-01') RETURN r.name AS RoleName, COUNT(res) AS NumberOfResources

question: For each group, find the number of distinct resources accessed by its members through temporary access grants, considering only resources with a sensitivity level of 'Internal'. Order results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Internal'}) RETURN g.name AS group_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS internal_resources_accessed_via_temp_access ORDER BY internal_resources_accessed_via_temp_access DESC

question: Find the top 10 policies that enforce roles which grant access to the highest number of resources of type 'Database'. Include the policy name and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN p.name, COUNT(res) AS db_resource_count ORDER BY db_resource_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: List all roles which grant access to at least three resources of type 'Database' and are compliant. Also return the number of such resources per role.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 3 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, resource_count AS NumberOfResources

question: For each department, calculate the average number of access attempts per user, considering only users who have made at least one access attempt.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS user_id, COUNT(ae) AS attempts NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(attempts) AS avg_access_attempts_per_user ORDER BY avg_access_attempts_per_user DESC

question: For each role that is marked as compliant, calculate the average number of resources it grants access to, considering only those roles that grant access to at least one resource. Order the results by the average number of resources in descending order.
gql: MATCH (role:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN role, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 1 RETURN role.name AS role_name, AVG(resource_count) AS avg_resources ORDER BY avg_resources DESC

question: Find all roles that are enforced by policies reviewed as 'Approved' and grant access to more than two resources. Include the role name, description, and the count of resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, count(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 2 RETURN r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description, resource_count

question: Identify users who have roles marked as non-compliant and have accessed more than two distinct resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential'.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false}), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Confidential'}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS confidential_resource_count NEXT FILTER confidential_resource_count > 2 RETURN u.name, confidential_resource_count

question: Return the top 3 most recently granted temporary accesses, including the user's name, resource name, reason for access, and grant timestamp, sorted by the grant time.
gql: MATCH (ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource), (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta) RETURN u.name, r.name, ta.reason, ta.granted_at ORDER BY ta.granted_at DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 3 resources with the highest number of distinct roles granting access to them, including the resource name and count of roles.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN res, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count NEXT RETURN res.name AS ResourceName, role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve a list of policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Pending'. Include the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description

question: Find groups whose members have accessed resources with an 'Internal' sensitivity level and return the group name along with the average number of access events per member.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Internal'}) RETURN g, u, count(ae) AS access_count NEXT RETURN g.name AS group_name, avg(access_count) AS average_accesses_per_member

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and were created after January 1, 2025. Include the policy name, role name, and resource name in the results.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) WHERE res.created_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN p.name AS policy_name, r.name AS role_name, res.name AS resource_name

question: Find users who belong to more than one group and have been granted temporary access to at least one resource. Return the user's name, the count of groups they belong to, and the count of temporary accesses they have been granted.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u, count(g) AS group_count NEXT FILTER group_count > 1 MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u, group_count, count(t) AS temp_access_count NEXT FILTER temp_access_count >= 1 RETURN u.name AS user_name, group_count, temp_access_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and have at least one non-compliant role, listing the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.description

question: Identify resources that have been accessed more than 5 times by users belonging to the 'Engineering' department, showing the resource name and access count.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u2:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Engineering' RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 5 RETURN r.name, access_count

question: Find all groups that contain users from the 'Engineering' department and count how many such users are in each group, returning only those groups with more than 3 engineering users.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'Engineering' RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS engineer_count NEXT FILTER engineer_count > 3 RETURN g.name AS GroupName, engineer_count

question: List all roles that grant access to at least five resources and are associated with at least two different policies, showing the role name and the count of distinct resources and policies.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 5 MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r) RETURN r, resource_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 2 RETURN r.name, resource_count, policy_count

question: Retrieve the top 5 most frequently accessed resources by users with a 'FAILURE' outcome, including the resource name and the total number of failure attempts, sorted by the number of failures in descending order.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS failure_count NEXT RETURN r.name, failure_count ORDER BY failure_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Count how many distinct resources each user has attempted to access unsuccessfully. Only consider users whose status is 'Active'. Return the user ID and the count of failed access attempts, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User{status:'Active'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS failed_access_count NEXT RETURN u.User_id, failed_access_count ORDER BY failed_access_count DESC

question: For each department, calculate the average number of accesses per user to resources that are not of type 'Application'. Only include departments where this average is greater than 2.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type <> 'Application' RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS user_id, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(access_count) AS avg_accesses_per_user NEXT FILTER avg_accesses_per_user > 2 RETURN dept AS Department, avg_accesses_per_user AS AverageAccessesPerUser

question: List all roles that are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Pending' and grant access to at least five resources. Include the role name, description, and the count of resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count >= 5 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.description AS RoleDescription, resource_count AS ResourceCount

question: List all groups that contain users from the 'Finance' department and have at least one member who has accessed a resource of type 'Database'. Include the group name and the count of such distinct users.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User{department:'Finance'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g, u NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS DistinctUsersCount

question: Identify users who belong to more than two groups and have a role type of 'Admin'. Return their names and the number of groups they belong to.
gql: MATCH (u:User{role_type:'Admin'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u, COUNT(g) AS group_count NEXT FILTER group_count > 2 RETURN u.name AS user_name, group_count

question: Retrieve the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Finance' department, including the resource name, type, and the number of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Finance'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name AS resourceName, r.type AS resourceType, COUNT(ae) AS accessCount ORDER BY accessCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all groups created by users in the 'IT' department along with the count of members in each group, sorted by member count in descending order. Include only groups with more than 3 members.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User{department:'IT'}) RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS member_count NEXT FILTER member_count > 3 RETURN g.name AS group_name, member_count ORDER BY member_count DESC

question: Retrieve a list of resources that have been accessed more than 10 times with a failure outcome, along with the resource name, type, and the count of failed access attempts.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS failed_attempts NEXT FILTER failed_attempts > 10 RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType, failed_attempts AS FailedAccessCount

question: Retrieve the average number of resources accessed per user for each department, considering only successful access events. Exclude departments with fewer than 3 users.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, u.department AS dept, COUNT(r) AS resources_accessed NEXT MATCH (dept_users:User{department:dept}) RETURN dept, AVG(resources_accessed) AS avg_resources_per_user, COUNT(dept_users) AS user_count NEXT FILTER user_count >= 3 RETURN dept AS Department, avg_resources_per_user AS AvgResourcesPerUser

question: Identify resources that have been accessed by users from more than one department and return the resource name, the count of distinct departments, and the latest access timestamp.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT u.department) AS dept_count, MAX(ae.`timestamp`) AS latest_access NEXT FILTER dept_count > 1 RETURN r.name AS resource_name, dept_count, latest_access

question: Identify users who have been granted temporary access to resources but have never attempted access to those same resources, returning their names and the resource names.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE NOT EXISTS ((u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r)) RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS UserName, r.name AS ResourceName

question: List all roles that are compliant and are enforced by policies that have a review status of 'Approved'. For each such role, return the role name, description, and the count of distinct resources it grants access to, but only include roles that grant access to more than 3 resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description, resource_count

question: Identify users who belong to groups created by users from the 'HR' department and have attempted access to resources with an outcome of 'FAILURE'. Return the user's name, the group name, and the count of failed access attempts, ordered by the count of failures.
gql: MATCH (hr_user:User{department:'HR'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'}) RETURN u.name AS UserName, g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(ae) AS FailedAttempts ORDER BY FailedAttempts DESC

question: Determine which roles grant access to both 'File Server' and 'API Endpoint' type resources and return the role names and their compliance status.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res1:Resource) WHERE res1.type = 'File Server' RETURN r NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res2:Resource) WHERE res2.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.is_compliant

question: Find all roles that are compliant and are associated with policies reviewed as 'Approved'. Also, list the resources granted by these roles, including the resource name and type.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name AS RoleName, res.name AS ResourceName, res.type AS ResourceType

question: Find roles that are associated with users from the 'IT' department and also enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Return the role names and the count of such users and policies.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'IT'})-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN r, COUNT(u) AS user_count NEXT MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r) RETURN r, user_count, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT RETURN r.name AS role_name, user_count, policy_count

question: Identify users who have been granted temporary access to resources and have also attempted access to those same resources through regular means. Return the user's name, the resource name, and the reason for temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r) RETURN u.name AS user_name, r.name AS resource_name, ta.reason AS reason_for_access

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which have been assigned to users in the 'Marketing' department. Return the policy name and the count of distinct users affected by each policy.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User {department: 'Marketing'}) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS affected_user_count

question: Retrieve a list of groups and the number of distinct resources accessed by their members, considering only successful access events.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS DistinctResourcesAccessed ORDER BY DistinctResourcesAccessed DESC

question: Identify groups that contain users who have roles granting access to more than five resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Include the group name, description, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN g, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN g.name AS GroupName, g.description AS GroupDescription, resource_count AS ResourceCount

question: List all roles that are compliant and are enforced by policies that have a review status of 'Approved'. Also, return the number of resources each role grants access to, but only for roles granting access to more than 10 resources.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 10 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, resource_count

question: Find all roles that are compliant and are granted by policies reviewed as 'Approved', which in turn grant access to at least one resource of type 'File Server'. List the role names and their permissions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE p.review_status = 'Approved' AND r.is_compliant = true AND res.type = 'File Server' RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.permissions_list

question: List all roles that are enforced by at least two different policies and grant access to resources of type 'File Server'. Include the role name and the count of distinct policies enforcing it.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'File Server'}) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 2 RETURN r.name AS role_name, policy_count

question: Retrieve the top 5 groups with the highest number of members, including only those groups whose members belong to the 'Engineering' department. For each group, return its name, description, and member count.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'Engineering' RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS member_count ORDER BY member_count DESC LIMIT 5 NEXT RETURN g.name AS group_name, g.description AS group_description, member_count

question: Retrieve policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Public' and have not been reviewed yet (review_status is 'Pending'). Return the policy name, description, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Public'}) RETURN p, COUNT(res) AS public_resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description, public_resource_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to at least one resource of type 'Database' and were reviewed as 'Approved'. Include the policy name and the count of such database resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, COUNT(res) AS DatabaseResourceCount

question: List all groups that have members who have roles marked as non-compliant and count how many such members exist in each group. Order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false}) RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(u) AS NonCompliantMembers ORDER BY NonCompliantMembers DESC

question: Find roles that are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Pending' and also grant access to at least one resource with a type of 'Database'. Return the role names and the count of such database resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN r.name AS RoleName, COUNT(res) AS DatabaseResourceCount

question: Determine which roles are associated with policies having a review status of 'Pending' and also grant access to at least one resource of type 'API Endpoint'. Return the role names and descriptions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description

question: Retrieve audit logs for actions performed by users who have accessed resources of type 'Database' more than three times. Include the action, timestamp, and details from the audit logs.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 3 MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN al.action AS Action, al.`timestamp` AS `Timestamp`, al.details AS Details

question: List all roles that are compliant and are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Additionally, include the number of permissions each role has listed in its permissions_list property, assuming permissions are comma-separated.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true}) RETURN r, SIZE(r.permissions_list) AS permission_count NEXT RETURN r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description, permission_count

question: Identify groups whose members have attempted access to resources resulting in failures, and calculate the average number of failed access attempts per member within those groups.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'}) RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS failed_attempts NEXT RETURN g.name AS group_name, AVG(failed_attempts) AS avg_failed_attempts_per_member

question: List all roles that are compliant and are granted by policies effective after January 1, 2023, including the role name and the policy name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: true}) WHERE p.effective_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN r.name AS RoleName, p.name AS PolicyName

question: Retrieve the names of users who have attempted access to resources more than 5 times with a 'FAILURE' outcome and also have at least one successful access attempt. Return the user name and the count of failed and successful attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS failed_attempts NEXT FILTER failed_attempts > 5 MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae2:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'}) RETURN u, failed_attempts, COUNT(ae2) AS success_attempts NEXT FILTER success_attempts >= 1 RETURN u.name AS user_name, failed_attempts, success_attempts

question: Identify resources that are governed by policies enforcing at least two distinct roles, and return the resource name, type, and the number of distinct roles enforcing it.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN res, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count NEXT FILTER role_count >= 2 RETURN res.name, res.type, role_count

question: Identify resources that have been accessed via temporary access assignments and also directly through role-based grants, listing the resource names and sensitivity levels.
gql: MATCH (res:Resource)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN res NEXT MATCH (res)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(r:Role) RETURN DISTINCT res.name, res.sensitivity_level

question: Find users who have roles marked as non-compliant and have accessed resources with a 'SUCCESS' outcome, returning their names and the count of successful accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS success_count

question: List all groups created by users in the 'HR' department, including the group name and the number of members, but only for groups that have more than five members.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'HR'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count > 5 RETURN g.name AS group_name, g.member_count AS member_count

question: For each policy, find the number of distinct roles it enforces and the average number of resources each of those roles grants access to, considering only policies with at least one associated role.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count_per_role NEXT RETURN p.name AS policy_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS distinct_roles_count, AVG(resource_count_per_role) AS avg_resources_per_role

question: Retrieve the names of users who belong to groups with more than 5 members and have attempted access to resources with an 'SUCCESS' outcome. Include the group name, user name, and the count of successful accesses, ordered by the count of successful accesses in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE g.member_count > 5 RETURN g, u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS success_count NEXT RETURN g.name AS group_name, u.name AS user_name, success_count ORDER BY success_count DESC

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to at least five resources of different types, and also list the average number of accesses per resource type under those policies.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(DISTINCT res.type) AS resource_types_count, COUNT(res) AS total_resources NEXT FILTER resource_types_count >= 5 RETURN p, resource_types_count, total_resources NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, AVG(total_resources) AS avg_accesses_per_resource_type

question: Find all roles that are enforced by at least two different policies and grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Return the role name and the count of such policies.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 2 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, policy_count AS NumberOfPolicies

question: Find policies that are enforced by roles which are assigned to users who have attempted access to resources more than 5 times with a failure outcome. Return the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'}) RETURN p, u, COUNT(ae) AS failure_count NEXT FILTER failure_count > 5 RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription

question: Determine the number of users in each group who have roles that are marked as compliant and have accessed resources of type 'Database' at least once.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true}), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g, u NEXT RETURN g.name AS group_name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count

question: Return the names of users who have attempted access to resources but their access outcome was 'FAILURE', along with the resource name and the access timestamp. Order the results by the most recent access attempt.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u.name AS user_name, r.name AS resource_name, ae.`timestamp` AS access_time ORDER BY ae.`timestamp` DESC

question: List all groups and for each group, calculate the average number of access events per user. Only consider users who have made at least one access attempt.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, AVG(access_count) AS AverageAccessEventsPerUser

question: For each policy that enforces at least one non-compliant role, list the policy name and the total number of resources those roles grant access to, excluding resources of type 'API Endpoint'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type <> 'API Endpoint' RETURN p, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, resource_count AS TotalResources

question: Find all roles that are enforced by more than one policy and grant access to resources with a type of 'Database'. Return the role names and the count of such policies, ordered by the policy count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count > 1 RETURN r.name, policy_count ORDER BY policy_count DESC

question: Determine the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Finance' department, including the resource name and the number of access events. Consider only successful access outcomes.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Finance'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of users who have attempted access to resources from the same IP address more than once, and the outcome of those attempts was 'SUCCESS'. Include the user name, IP address, and the count of successful attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'}) RETURN u, ae.ip_address AS ip, COUNT(ae) AS success_count NEXT FILTER success_count > 1 RETURN u.name AS user_name, ip, success_count

question: Retrieve a list of policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database', including the policy name, description, and the count of such resources, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS Description, COUNT(res) AS ResourceCount ORDER BY ResourceCount DESC

question: Identify roles that grant access to both 'Database' and 'API Endpoint' type resources, and are enforced by at least two different policies. Return the role name and the count of such policies.
gql: MATCH (p1:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res1:Resource{type:'Database'}), (p2:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res2:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT p1) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 2 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, policy_count AS EnforcingPoliciesCount

question: Determine the top 3 groups with the highest member counts and list all users belonging to these groups along with their last login date.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`) RETURN g ORDER BY g.member_count DESC LIMIT 3 NEXT MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g) RETURN g.name AS group_name, u.name AS user_name, u.last_login AS last_login_date

question: Retrieve roles that are not compliant and are associated with users who have accessed more than five resources. Return the role name, description, and the number of distinct resources accessed by users holding this role.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:false})<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN r.name AS role_name, r.description AS role_description, resource_count

question: Show groups that have members who have accessed more than 5 distinct resources successfully. Return the group name and the average number of accesses per member.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN g, u, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resourceCount NEXT FILTER resourceCount > 5 RETURN g, AVG(resourceCount) AS avgAccessesPerMember NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, avgAccessesPerMember

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which have been assigned to users in the 'IT' department and these users have accessed resources with an outcome of 'SUCCESS'. Include the policy name and the count of successful accesses.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User {department: 'IT'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'}) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, COUNT(ae) AS SuccessfulAccesses

question: Identify all resources that are targeted by access events with a 'SUCCESS' outcome but do not have any associated temporary access granted. Return the resource names and types.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'}) WHERE NOT EXISTS ((:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r)) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType

question: Which users have accessed resources both through regular access and temporary access? Provide the user names and the count of distinct resources accessed in each way.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res1:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT res1) AS regularAccessCount NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res2:Resource) RETURN u, regularAccessCount, COUNT(DISTINCT res2) AS tempAccessCount NEXT RETURN u.name AS userName, regularAccessCount, tempAccessCount

question: Retrieve a list of all policies along with the total number of roles they enforce and the average number of resources each of those roles grants access to, only including policies where the average is greater than 2.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p, COUNT(r) AS role_count, AVG(resource_count) AS avg_resources_per_role NEXT FILTER avg_resources_per_role > 2 RETURN p.name, role_count, avg_resources_per_role

question: Retrieve all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and were created after January 1, 2023. Include the policy name, effective date, and the description of the enforced role.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) WHERE p.effective_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.effective_date AS effective_date, r.description AS role_description

question: Retrieve roles that are not compliant and are associated with users who have accessed resources more than 10 times with a failure outcome. Return the role name, user name, and the count of failures, ordered by the failure count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false}), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'}) RETURN r, u, COUNT(ae) AS failure_count NEXT FILTER failure_count > 10 RETURN r.name, u.name, failure_count ORDER BY failure_count DESC

question: For each department, calculate the average number of roles per user, considering only users who have at least one role. Include departments with an average higher than 2 roles per user, and sort the results by this average in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN u.department AS dept, u, COUNT(r) AS role_count NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(role_count) AS avg_roles_per_user NEXT FILTER avg_roles_per_user > 2 RETURN dept, avg_roles_per_user ORDER BY avg_roles_per_user DESC

question: Find the average number of access events per user for each department, considering only users who have attempted access more than 5 times. Return the department and the average access event count.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, u.department AS dept, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 5 RETURN dept, AVG(access_count) AS avg_access_events_per_user

question: List all groups created by users from the 'IT' department, including the group name, description, and the creator's name, ensuring that the group has at least five members.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'IT'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count >= 5 RETURN g.name AS GroupName, g.description AS Description, u.name AS CreatorName

question: For each policy that enforces at least one role granting temporary access to resources, return the policy name, the number of roles it enforces, and the total number of temporary accesses granted through those roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS roles_enforced, COUNT(ta) AS temp_accesses_granted NEXT RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, roles_enforced AS RolesEnforced, temp_accesses_granted AS TemporaryAccessesGranted

question: Retrieve all groups created by users who belong to the 'IT' department and have at least 5 members. Include the group name, description, and member count.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User{department:'IT'}) WHERE g.member_count >= 5 RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS GroupName, g.description AS Description, g.member_count AS MemberCount

question: Find users who have attempted access to resources more than 10 times and return their name, department, and the average number of access attempts per resource.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, r, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts NEXT FILTER access_attempts > 10 RETURN u, AVG(access_attempts) AS avg_attempts_per_resource NEXT RETURN u.name AS UserName, u.department AS Department, avg_attempts_per_resource

question: Identify resources that are governed by policies which enforce roles that are not marked as compliant. Return the resource names and the associated non-compliant role names.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(ro:Role {is_compliant: false})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS ResourceName, ro.name AS NonCompliantRoleName

question: List all roles that are compliant and grant access to at least one resource of type 'Database'. For each role, return the role name, description, and the number of database resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS db_resource_count NEXT FILTER db_resource_count >= 1 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.description AS Description, db_resource_count AS DatabaseResourceCount

question: Find users who have attempted access to more than three different resources and all their access attempts resulted in failure. Return the user's name, email, and the count of distinct resources they attempted to access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN u.name AS UserName, u.email AS UserEmail, resource_count AS DistinctResourceAttempts
