question: Identify users who have roles that grant access to more than five resources and belong to groups with a member count greater than ten. Return the user's name, their role name, and the number of resources they have access to, ordered by the number of resources in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 MATCH (u)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u.name AS UserName, r.name AS RoleName, resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: List all resources that have never been targeted by any access events and return their name and type.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE NOT EXISTS((r)<-[:Targets]-(:AccessEvent)) RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType

question: List all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and were reviewed with status 'Pending'. Include the policy name, description, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p, COUNT(res) AS api_endpoint_count NEXT RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description, api_endpoint_count

question: Find the top 3 users who have the highest number of failed access attempts (outcome = 'FAILURE') to resources of type 'Database'. Include their name, email, and the count of failures.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS failure_count ORDER BY failure_count DESC LIMIT 3 NEXT RETURN u.name AS user_name, u.email AS email, failure_count

question: Retrieve the top 3 most recently created policies that are currently under review (review_status = 'Pending') and list the roles they enforce along with the permissions list of those roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) RETURN p, r ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC LIMIT 3 NEXT RETURN p.name AS policy_name, r.name AS role_name, r.permissions_list AS role_permissions

question: Retrieve the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Sales' department, showing the resource name and the number of successful accesses, excluding resources with less than 3 accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Sales'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, COUNT(ae) AS AccessCount ORDER BY AccessCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find groups that have at least one member with a role that grants access to resources of type 'Database'. Return the group name and the count of such unique members.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g.name AS GroupName, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS UniqueMembersWithDBAccess

question: List all policies that enforce roles which are not compliant and grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Additionally, include the policy's effective date and the count of non-compliant roles associated with each policy.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: false})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.effective_date AS EffectiveDate, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS NonCompliantRoleCount

question: For each group, calculate the average number of access events per user, considering only users who have made at least one access attempt. Return the group name and the calculated average.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS user_access_count NEXT RETURN g, AVG(user_access_count) AS avg_access_per_user NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, avg_access_per_user AS AverageAccessPerUser

question: Find all roles that are not compliant but are still associated with at least one approved policy. List the role names and descriptions along with the count of associated approved policies.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: false})-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'}) RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.description AS RoleDescription, COUNT(p) AS ApprovedPolicyCount

question: List all roles that are compliant and have been assigned to users who have attempted access to more than five different resources. Include the role name and the number of such users.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, u, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN r.name AS role_name, COUNT(u) AS user_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database', and these policies must have been effective after January 1, 2023. Additionally, the roles enforced by these policies must be compliant. Return the policy name, description, and the role names.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) WHERE p.effective_date > DATE('2023-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description, r.name AS role_name

question: List all users who belong to groups that were created by users in the 'IT' department and have attempted access to resources with an outcome of 'FAILURE'. Include the user's name, the group name, and the timestamp of the failed access attempt.
gql: MATCH (creator:User{department:'IT'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome = 'FAILURE' RETURN u.name AS user_name, g.name AS group_name, ae.`timestamp` AS failed_access_time

question: Find roles that are associated with users who have accessed resources from more than three different IP addresses and have also been granted temporary access to at least one resource. Return the role name and the number of distinct IP addresses used by users with that role.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, r, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.ip_address) AS ip_count NEXT FILTER ip_count > 3 MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS role_name, ip_count

question: Find groups that contain users who have accessed resources located in more than two different departments. For each group, return its name and the total number of distinct departments associated with its members' accessed resources.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN g, COUNT(DISTINCT u.department) AS dept_count NEXT FILTER dept_count > 2 RETURN g.name, dept_count

question: Determine the average number of access events per user for users who have attempted access to resources governed by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Only consider users from the 'IT' department.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'IT'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'}) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS event_count NEXT RETURN AVG(event_count) AS AverageAccessEventsPerUser

question: Retrieve the names of users who have accessed more than five resources of type 'API Endpoint' and belong to the 'Engineering' department. Also, include the total count of such accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'Engineering'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 5 RETURN u.name AS user_name, access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC

question: List all roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and have been enforced by policies that were effective in the year 2023. Include the role name and the policy name.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) WHERE p.effective_date >= date('2023-01-01') AND p.effective_date <= date('2023-12-31') RETURN r.name AS RoleName, p.name AS PolicyName

question: Identify users who belong to groups with more than 5 members and have attempted access to resources with a failure outcome. Return the user names and the count of such failed access attempts.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'}) WHERE g.member_count > 5 RETURN u.name AS UserName, COUNT(ae) AS FailedAccessCount

question: Find policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than 3 resources and have a review status of 'Approved'. Return the policy name, description, and the count of resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription, resource_count

question: Identify users who have attempted access but none of their attempts resulted in a 'SUCCESS' outcome, and show their names along with the total number of failed access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE ae.outcome <> 'SUCCESS' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS failedAttempts NEXT FILTER failedAttempts > 0 RETURN u.name AS userName, failedAttempts

question: Show the top 3 departments based on the average number of temporary accesses granted per user within each department, including the department name and the average count.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u.department AS dept, u, COUNT(ta) AS tempAccesses NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(tempAccesses) AS avgTempAccesses ORDER BY avgTempAccesses DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than 5 resources. For each such policy, return its name and the average number of resources per role it enforces.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN p, AVG(resource_count) AS avg_resources_per_role NEXT RETURN p.name, avg_resources_per_role

question: Retrieve the names of users who belong to groups created by users from the 'IT' department and have attempted access to resources with an outcome of 'FAILURE'. Include the group name and the resource name.
gql: MATCH (creator:User{department:'IT'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN DISTINCT g NEXT MATCH (g)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'FAILURE'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u.name, g.name, r.name

question: Determine which resources were accessed via temporary access assignments by users whose status is 'Inactive'. Also include the reason for temporary access and the expiration date of the access.
gql: MATCH (u:User {status: 'Inactive'})-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, ta.reason, ta.expires_at

question: Identify the top 5 most frequently accessed resources by users from the 'IT' department, including the resource name, type, and the number of access events.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'IT'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType, access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all policies that are associated with resources accessed by users in the 'HR' department through roles marked as non-compliant. Include the policy name, description, and the count of distinct non-compliant roles involved.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'HR'})-[:HasRole]->(r:Role {is_compliant: false})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(p:Policy) RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS PolicyDescription, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS NonCompliantRolesCount

question: For each role that has at least one associated policy enforcing it, determine the average number of resources it grants access to. Include the role name and the calculated average in the result.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r NEXT MATCH (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name AS RoleName, COUNT(res) AS AvgResourcesGranted

question: Identify groups with members who have roles enforced by more than two policies and have accessed at least one resource of type 'Database'. Return the group name and the count of such members.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN g, u, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count > 2 MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS member_count NEXT RETURN g.name AS GroupName, member_count AS MemberCount

question: List all roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and grant access to more than 5 resources. For each role, return the role name, description, and the count of resources it grants access to, ordered by the resource count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resourceCount NEXT FILTER resourceCount > 5 RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.description AS Description, resourceCount ORDER BY resourceCount DESC

question: Identify resources that have been accessed by users with a role type of 'Admin' and have a sensitivity level of 'Confidential'. Return the resource name, type, and the count of distinct users who accessed it.
gql: MATCH (u:User {role_type: 'Admin'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource {sensitivity_level: 'Confidential'}) RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS UserCount

question: Retrieve policies that are associated with roles granting access to more than 5 resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Include the policy name, description, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p, r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.description AS Description, resource_count

question: Find users who belong to groups created by users in the 'HR' department and have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Internal'. Return the user name, group name, and the outcome of the access attempt.
gql: MATCH (hr_user:User{department:'HR'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Internal'}) RETURN u.name AS UserName, g.name AS GroupName, ae.outcome AS AccessOutcome

question: List roles that grant access to more than 5 resources and are linked to at least one policy with a review status of 'Pending'. Include the role name, permissions list, and the count of associated pending policies.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[grants:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 MATCH (r)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'}) RETURN r, resource_count, COUNT(p) AS pending_policy_count NEXT RETURN r.name AS role_name, r.permissions_list AS permissions_list, pending_policy_count

question: Retrieve the most recently created group along with its creator's name and the total number of members in that group. If the group has no members, the member count should be zero.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`) RETURN g ORDER BY g.created_date DESC LIMIT 1 NEXT MATCH (g)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) RETURN g.name AS GroupName, g.created_by AS CreatorName, COUNT(u) AS MemberCount

question: Identify roles that are compliant and are associated with users who have been granted temporary access to at least one resource. Return the role name and the count of such users.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count NEXT FILTER user_count >= 1 RETURN r.name AS role_name, user_count

question: Identify roles that are compliant (`is_compliant: true`) and are associated with users who have attempted access to resources with an outcome of 'SUCCESS'. Return the role names and the total number of successful access attempts made by users in these roles.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent {outcome: 'SUCCESS'}) RETURN r.name AS role_name, COUNT(ae) AS successful_access_attempts

question: For each department, calculate the average number of groups its users belong to, considering only active users (status = 'Active'). Return the department name and the computed average.
gql: MATCH (u:User{status:'Active'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS user_id, COUNT(g) AS group_count_per_user NEXT RETURN dept AS department, AVG(group_count_per_user) AS avg_groups_per_user

question: Retrieve the names of roles that are compliant and are granted by policies reviewed as 'Approved'. Also, these roles should grant access to at least one resource of type 'Database'. Return the role names and their descriptions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: For each department, calculate the total number of successful access events by users in that department. Only include departments where the total number of successful accesses is greater than 20. Return the department name and the total count of successful accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User{status:'Active'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent{outcome:'SUCCESS'})-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u.department AS dept, COUNT(ae) AS success_count NEXT FILTER success_count > 20 RETURN dept, success_count

question: Identify resources that have been accessed by users from the 'Finance' department more than 10 times and are governed by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Return the resource name, type, and access count.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'Finance'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'}) RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 10 RETURN r.name AS ResourceName, r.type AS ResourceType, access_count AS AccessCount

question: Which departments have users who accessed resources through both direct role assignments and temporary access?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r) RETURN DISTINCT u.department

question: Which users belong to groups with a higher member count than the average group size across all groups in the system?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN avg(g.member_count) AS avg_member_count NEXT MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count > avg_member_count RETURN DISTINCT u

question: Identify the shortest traversal path from a User to a Resource considering only direct role-based access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, r, res

question: List all possible traversal paths from a Role to a Resource including intermediate TemporaryAccess assignments.
gql: MATCH (role:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(resource:Resource) RETURN role, resource UNION MATCH (role:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(resource:Resource) RETURN role, resource

question: Show all paths between a Group and a Resource by traversing through Users who belong to the group and have accessed the resource.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[a:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN g, u, ae, r

question: How many resources does each role grant access to, and what is the average number of resources per role?
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.Role_id AS role_id, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN role_id, resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: What is the average member count of groups that contain users who have accessed high-sensitivity resources?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS member_count NEXT MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'high' RETURN AVG(member_count) AS average_member_count

question: What is the total number of access events grouped by outcome, and which outcome type occurs most frequently?
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent) RETURN ae.outcome AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS total_events ORDER BY total_events DESC

question: Does a policy named 'Compliance Policy 9' exist that enforces a role granting access to a resource of type 'API Endpoint'?
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {name: 'Compliance Policy 9'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN COUNT(*) > 0 AS policyExists

question: Is there a user with the ID 'U000013' who owns a resource with the sensitivity level marked as 'Internal'?
gql: MATCH (u:User {User_id: 'U000013'})-[:HasRole]->(:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource {sensitivity_level: 'Internal'}) RETURN u, r

question: How many policies are currently enforcing roles that grant access to critical resources?
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'critical' RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count

question: Which role grants access to the highest number of resources, and how many resources does it grant access to?
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name AS role_name, COUNT(res) AS resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of resources created in the last quarter, grouped by their sensitivity level?
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE r.created_date >= date('2023-04-01') AND r.created_date <= date('2023-06-30') RETURN r.sensitivity_level, count(*) AS total_resources ORDER BY total_resources DESC

question: What is the average number of members in groups that have at least one user who accessed a high-sensitivity resource?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS member_count NEXT MATCH (u2:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g) RETURN g, member_count NEXT MATCH (u2)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'high' RETURN AVG(member_count) AS average_members

question: Which resources are connected to both a specific user through direct role assignment and to another user through temporary access?
gql: MATCH (u1:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u2:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) WHERE u1.User_id <> u2.User_id RETURN DISTINCT res.Resource_id AS ResourceID

question: Find temporary access grants that are linked to the same resource and are assigned to users from the same department.
gql: MATCH (u1:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta1:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(ta2:TemporaryAccess)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(u2:User) WHERE u1.department = u2.department RETURN ta1, ta2, r

question: Find all roles that grant access to more than 5 resources, and sort them by the number of resources in descending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN r, resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: How many resources does each role grant access to, and which roles grant access to more than 5 resources?
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, count(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 5 RETURN r.name, resource_count

question: What are the different traversal paths from a Role to a Resource, including intermediate TemporaryAccess assignments?
gql: MATCH (role:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(resource:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT role.Role_id, resource.Resource_id UNION MATCH (role:Role)-[:HasRole]->(:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(resource:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT role.Role_id, resource.Resource_id

question: Identify policies that became effective after the policy named 'Compliance Policy 9'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{name:'Compliance Policy 9'}) RETURN p.effective_date AS target_date NEXT MATCH (other:Policy) WHERE other.effective_date > target_date RETURN other

question: Which users have accessed resources more recently than the user with email 'amandaerickson@example.net'?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.email = 'amandaerickson@example.net' RETURN MAX(ae.`timestamp`) AS latest_access_time NEXT MATCH (u2:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae2:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r2:Resource) WHERE ae2.`timestamp` > latest_access_time RETURN DISTINCT u2.name

question: Identify the shortest traversal path from a User in the 'Engineering' department to a Resource owned by a User in the 'Sales' department.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Engineering'})-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(rs:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(us:User {department: 'Sales'}) RETURN u, r, res, rs, us

question: List all paths from a Role with compliance status 'true' to a Resource with a creation date after '2025-01-01'.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN r, res

question: What are all the paths between a Group created by 'U000168' and a Resource accessed by Users belonging to that group?
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`{created_by:'U000168'})-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT g, r

question: Identify all resources that are accessible through both a direct role assignment and a temporary access grant for the same user, showcasing dual access pathways.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) RETURN DISTINCT res.Resource_id AS ResourceId

question: Which resources are connected to users through both direct role assignments and group memberships, demonstrating indirect access through organizational structure?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN DISTINCT res

question: List all roles that are connected to the same temporary access grants, showing indirect relationships between roles through shared temporary permissions.
gql: MATCH (r1:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(r2:Role) RETURN r1, r2 NEXT FILTER r1.Role_id < r2 RETURN DISTINCT r1.name AS Role1, r2.name AS Role2

question: Which policies enforce roles that grant access to the same resources, highlighting potential overlaps in policy coverage and resource management?
gql: MATCH (p1:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r1:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (p2:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r2:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE p1.Policy_id <> p2.Policy_id RETURN DISTINCT p1.name AS Policy1, p2.name AS Policy2, res.name AS Resource ORDER BY Policy1, Policy2, Resource

question: Identify all users who can access the resource with ID 'R000041' through both permanent role assignments and temporary access grants.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.Resource_id = 'R000041' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r) WHERE r.Resource_id = 'R000041' RETURN DISTINCT u

question: Which type of resources can be accessed by users in the 'Engineering' department through both permanent role assignments and temporary access grants?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Engineering' RETURN res NEXT MATCH (u2:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) WHERE u2.department = 'Engineering' RETURN DISTINCT res.type

question: Which roles grant access to resources created more recently than the resource named 'meeting Document'?
gql: MATCH (r:Resource{name:'meeting Document'}) RETURN r.created_date AS target_date NEXT MATCH (role:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date > target_date RETURN DISTINCT role.name

question: Identify all policies that enforce roles granting access to resources created after '2025-01-01', and return the policy names along with the resource names.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN p.name AS policy_name, res.name AS resource_name

question: Show all paths connecting a Policy to a Resource through the enforcement of Roles, including the role names and resource details.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, r.name AS role_name, res.name AS resource_name, res.type AS resource_type, res.sensitivity_level AS sensitivity_level

question: Does a user with the ID 'U000013' exist in the database?
gql: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.User_id = 'U000013' RETURN u

question: Does a resource named 'meeting Document' exist that was created before '2024-01-01'?
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE r.name = 'meeting Document' AND r.created_date < date('2024-01-01') RETURN r

question: Does a role named 'Auditor 1' exist that grants access to more than 5 resources?
gql: MATCH (r:Role{name:'Auditor 1'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, count(res) AS resourceCount NEXT FILTER resourceCount > 5 RETURN r

question: Is there any resource with the sensitivity level marked as 'Internal'?
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Internal' RETURN r

question: Retrieve policies that became effective after '2025-03-01' and have a review status of 'Approved', sorted by their effective date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy) WHERE p.effective_date > date('2025-03-01') AND p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN p ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC

question: List all resources created after '2025-01-01' with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential', sorted by their creation date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE r.created_date > date('2025-01-01') AND r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN r ORDER BY r.created_date ASC

question: Find all possible paths connecting a Policy named 'Compliance Policy 9' to a Resource of type 'API Endpoint'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {name: 'Compliance Policy 9'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p, r

question: Which paths connect a Policy with review status 'Approved' to a Resource through the enforcement of Roles?
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, res

question: Find the different traversal paths from a Role named 'Auditor 1' to a Resource either directly or through temporary access assignments.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {name: 'Auditor 1'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT r, res UNION MATCH (r:Role {name: 'Auditor 1'})<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT r, res

question: Identify all resources that are accessible through both a direct role assignment and a temporary access grant for the same user.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource), (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(res) RETURN DISTINCT res

question: Identify all policies that became effective after March 1, 2025, and have a review status of 'Pending', sorted by their effective date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy) WHERE p.effective_date > date('2025-03-01') AND p.review_status = 'Pending' RETURN p ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC

question: List all resources created after January 1, 2025, with a sensitivity level of 'Public', sorted by their creation date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource) WHERE r.created_date > date('2025-01-01') AND r.sensitivity_level = 'Public' RETURN r ORDER BY r.created_date DESC

question: Find all resources that are accessible by both the 'Engineering' and 'Sales' departments through direct role assignments.
gql: MATCH (u1:User)-[:HasRole]->(r1:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE u1.department = 'Engineering' RETURN res NEXT MATCH (u2:User)-[:HasRole]->(r2:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res) WHERE u2.department = 'Sales' RETURN DISTINCT res

question: List all groups that have members accessing the same resources as the group named 'Project Linen 1'.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`{name:'Project Linen 1'})-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT r NEXT MATCH (ug:`Group`)-[:BelongsTo]-(uu:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r) RETURN DISTINCT ug.name AS group_name

question: What resources are accessed by users from both the 'IT' and 'HR' departments?

question: Identify the top 5 most accessed resources by counting the number of access events targeting each resource, and include the resource name and type in the results.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, r.type, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names and descriptions of roles that are enforced by policies which have a review status of 'Pending' and grant access to at least one resource.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: Find the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Sales' department, including the resource name and the number of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Sales'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all users who belong to groups with more than 10 members and have attempted access to resources, showing their names and the count of access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts_count

question: Retrieve audit logs for actions performed by users in the 'IT' department, including the action, timestamp, and details.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN al.action, al.`timestamp`, al.details

question: Determine how many policies are enforcing roles that have compliance issues, and list the policy names along with the count of non-compliant roles they enforce.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS non_compliant_role_count

question: Which resources were accessed by users having roles marked as non-compliant? Provide resource name and sensitivity level.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent)<-[:AttemptsAccess]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(role:Role) WHERE role.is_compliant = false RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.sensitivity_level

question: Find the average number of members in groups created by users with role type 'Admin', grouped by the group creator's name.
gql: MATCH (u:User{role_type:'Admin'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u.name, AVG(g.member_count) AS avg_members_per_group

question: List all groups along with the number of users in each group and the average number of roles per user in those groups.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) RETURN g.Group_id, g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count, COUNT(r) AS avg_roles_per_user

question: Identify resources that were accessed using temporary access and return the resource name, the reason for temporary access, and the expiration date of that access.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(ta:TemporaryAccess)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(u:User) RETURN r.name AS resource_name, ta.reason AS reason, ta.expires_at AS expires_at

question: Find the top 5 most frequently accessed resources by users who belong to the 'IT' department, including the resource name and the count of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'IT'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name AS resource_name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce at least one role which grants access to a resource of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Approved'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS policy_name

question: Which users have been granted temporary access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential', and how many such accesses does each user have?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u.name, COUNT(ta) AS tempAccessCount

question: Identify users who belong to groups with more than 10 members and have attempted access to resources more than twice. Return their names and the number of access attempts.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS accessAttempts NEXT FILTER accessAttempts > 2 RETURN u.name, accessAttempts

question: Count the number of non-compliant roles assigned to users in each department.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN u.department, COUNT(r) AS non_compliant_role_count ORDER BY non_compliant_role_count DESC

question: Which resources are accessible through roles that are enforced by policies currently under review ('Pending')?
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT res.name, res.Resource_id

question: Find all users who have temporary access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Restricted' and list their names along with the resource names and expiration dates, sorted by the expiration date.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(t:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Restricted' RETURN u.name, r.name, t.expires_at ORDER BY t.expires_at

question: Find all users who have attempted access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Restricted' and return their names, email addresses, and the outcome of their access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Restricted' RETURN u.name, u.email, ae.outcome

question: Which roles are associated with policies that have a review status of 'Pending' and grant access to more than one resource? Return the role names and the number of resources they grant access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 1 RETURN r.name, resource_count

question: Identify the number of non-compliant roles that are enforced by policies currently under review (review_status = 'Pending').
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN count(r) AS NonCompliantRolesCount

question: Find the average number of members in groups that have at least one user who has attempted access to a resource of type 'File Server'.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)-[:BelongsTo]->(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'File Server' RETURN AVG(g.member_count) AS avg_members_in_group

question: Which roles are compliant and are associated with resources that were created before the year 2023? Return the role name and description.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = true AND res.created_date < date('2023-01-01') RETURN r.name, r.description

question: Identify users who belong to more than one group and return their user IDs, names, and the count of groups they belong to, sorted by the group count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u.User_id, u.name, COUNT(g) AS group_count ORDER BY group_count DESC

question: List all resources that are granted access by roles which are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Return the resource names and their sensitivity levels, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT res.name, res.sensitivity_level

question: List all groups along with the count of active users in each group, sorted by the user count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.status = 'Active' RETURN g.name, COUNT(u) AS active_user_count ORDER BY active_user_count DESC

question: Find all groups created by users in the 'IT' department and list the group names along with the creators' names.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN g.name AS group_name, u.name AS creator_name

question: Identify resources that have both direct role-based access and temporary access granted, returning the resource name and its sensitivity level.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(:Role) RETURN r NEXT MATCH (r)<-[:AssignedTempAccess]-(:TemporaryAccess) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS resource_name, r.sensitivity_level AS sensitivity_level

question: Find the number of access events per user, including users with zero access events, and order the results by the number of access events in descending order.
gql: OPTIONAL MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name AS UserName, COUNT(ae) AS AccessEventCount ORDER BY AccessEventCount DESC

question: Find all policies that have been reviewed and are currently enforcing at least one role, displaying the policy name, review status, and role name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) WHERE p.review_status IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS PolicyName, p.review_status AS ReviewStatus, r.name AS RoleName

question: Find users who have attempted access events from more than two distinct IP addresses and return their names along with the count of distinct IP addresses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.ip_address) AS ip_count NEXT FILTER ip_count > 2 RETURN u.name, ip_count

question: Identify roles that are associated with at least three different policies and return the role name along with the number of associated policies.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 3 RETURN r.name, policy_count

question: Identify the roles that are associated with more than two policies and return the role name along with the count of associated policies, sorted in descending order by policy count.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count > 2 RETURN r.name AS role_name, policy_count ORDER BY policy_count DESC

question: For each resource type, calculate the average number of access events and list only those resource types where this average exceeds 5. Include the resource type and the calculated average.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.type AS resource_type, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT MATCH (r2:Resource) WHERE r2.type = resource_type RETURN resource_type, AVG(access_count) AS avg_accesses NEXT FILTER avg_accesses > 5 RETURN resource_type, avg_accesses

question: Find users who belong to more than one group and have attempted access to resources located in the 'API Endpoint' type, displaying their names and the count of distinct API endpoints they've tried to access.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u, COUNT(g) AS group_count NEXT FILTER group_count > 1 MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS api_endpoints_accessed

question: Retrieve a list of all groups and the number of users in each group who have roles that grant access to at least one resource of type 'Database'.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count

question: Identify roles that grant access to more than three resources and are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Return the role name and the number of resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN r.name, resource_count

question: Retrieve the names of policies, the roles they enforce, and the resources those roles grant access to, specifically for policies with a review status of 'Pending'.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: Find users who have attempted access to resources more than once and return their names, the count of their access attempts, and the average time between their first and last access attempt.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS attempt_count, MIN(ae.`timestamp`) AS first_attempt, MAX(ae.`timestamp`) AS last_attempt NEXT FILTER attempt_count > 1 RETURN u.name, attempt_count, attempt_count AS avg_time_between_attempts

question: For each department, calculate the average number of access events per user. Return the department name and the average access event count, sorted by the average in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS user_id, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT MATCH (d_user:User{User_id:user_id}) RETURN dept, AVG(access_count) AS avg_access_per_user NEXT RETURN dept, avg_access_per_user ORDER BY avg_access_per_user DESC

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which are assigned to users in the 'Finance' department and grant access to resources of type 'Application'. Show policy names and effective dates.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User), (r)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Finance' AND res.type = 'Application' RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.effective_date

question: Return the top 5 most frequently accessed resources of type 'API Endpoint' along with their access counts, including only accesses that were successful (outcome = 'SUCCESS').
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'API Endpoint' AND ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all roles that are compliant and list the policies enforcing these roles, including the policy's effective date and review status. Only include policies with an 'Approved' review status.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) WHERE p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN r.name, p.name, p.effective_date, p.review_status

question: What are the departments and the total number of compliant roles associated with users in each department?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role {is_compliant: true}) RETURN u.department, COUNT(r) AS compliant_roles_count ORDER BY compliant_roles_count DESC

question: Retrieve the top 5 most accessed resources by users from the 'IT' department, including the resource name and the count of access events.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent)<-[:AttemptsAccess]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources created after January 1, 2023, and return the policy name, role name, and resource name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.created_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: Find all users who have attempted access to resources but never had a successful outcome, and list their names along with the IP addresses used in their access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome <> 'Success' RETURN DISTINCT u.name, ae.ip_address

question: List all groups created by users in the 'IT' department, including the group name, description, and the number of members. Order the results by member count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN g, COUNT(u) AS member_count NEXT RETURN g.name, g.description, member_count ORDER BY member_count DESC

question: Identify users who have attempted access to resources more than once from the same IP address and return their names, email addresses, and the repeated IP address.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, ae.ip_address AS ip, COUNT(ae) AS attempts NEXT FILTER attempts > 1 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.email, ip

question: List all groups and the number of users in each group, including groups that currently have no users assigned.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN g.name, COUNT(u) AS user_count

question: Find the latest audit log entry for each user in the 'HR' department, including the action performed and its timestamp.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE u.department = 'HR' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN u.name, al.action, al.`timestamp` ORDER BY al.`timestamp` DESC

question: Retrieve the names and departments of users who have roles that grant access to more than 3 resources, along with the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN u.name, u.department, resource_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which have been assigned to users in the 'IT' department, and return the policy names and descriptions.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User) WHERE u.department = 'IT' RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.description

question: Return the names of resources and the number of successful access events for each resource, sorted by the number of successful accesses in descending order.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS success_count ORDER BY success_count DESC

question: Identify roles that are compliant and are enforced by policies reviewed as 'Pending'. Also, list the permissions associated with these roles and the resources they grant access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE p.review_status = 'Pending' RETURN r.name AS RoleName, r.permissions_list AS Permissions, res.name AS ResourceName

question: List the departments along with the average number of access events per user for those departments, considering only users who have at least one access event.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, u.department AS dept, COUNT(ae) AS accessCount NEXT FILTER accessCount > 0 RETURN dept, AVG(accessCount) AS avgAccessesPerUser

question: Retrieve the names of users who have both permanent roles granting access to 'Database' type resources and have also been granted temporary access to any resource. Ensure no duplicates in the results.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'Database' RETURN DISTINCT u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess) RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: List all groups and the number of active users in each group who have attempted access to resources more than 3 times. Only include groups where at least one user meets this criterion.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE u.status = 'Active' RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts NEXT FILTER access_attempts > 3 RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS active_user_count

question: Identify roles that are compliant and are granted by policies currently under review. Return the role names and descriptions, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy) WHERE r.is_compliant = true AND p.review_status = 'Under Review' RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: Find users who belong to more than one group and have attempted access to resources. Return their name, the number of groups they belong to, and the total number of access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u, COUNT(g) AS group_count NEXT FILTER group_count > 1 MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name, group_count, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts

question: Retrieve the names of roles that are not compliant and grant access to resources of type 'Database'. Also, include the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = false AND res.type = 'Database' RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS database_count

question: Find resources that are targeted by access events originating from more than two distinct IP addresses and return the resource name along with the count of distinct IP addresses.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.ip_address) AS ip_count NEXT FILTER ip_count > 2 RETURN r.name, ip_count

question: Identify the top 3 policies with the highest number of enforced roles that grant access to sensitive resources (sensitivity level 'Confidential'), returning the policy name and the count of such roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {sensitivity_level: 'Confidential'}) RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify groups that contain users who have been granted temporary access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Restricted'. Return the group names and the count of such temporary accesses.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Restricted' RETURN g.name, COUNT(ta) AS restricted_temp_access_count

question: List the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Finance' department, including the resource name and the number of access events, ordered by access count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u2:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.department = 'Finance' RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each department, find the average number of groups its users belong to, considering only active users (status = 'Active'). Return the department names and the calculated average, sorted by the average in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User{status:'Active'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN u.department AS dept, u.User_id AS user_id, COUNT(g) AS group_count NEXT RETURN dept, AVG(group_count) AS avg_groups NEXT RETURN dept, avg_groups ORDER BY avg_groups DESC

question: List all roles that are enforced by at least two different policies and grant access to resources of type 'Database'. Include the role name and the count of such databases.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS policy_count, COUNT(res) AS database_count NEXT FILTER policy_count >= 2 RETURN r.name, database_count

question: List all roles that are compliant and have permissions to access resources of type 'Database', along with the role name and description.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = true AND res.type = 'Database' RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: Determine the average number of access events per user for users in the 'IT' department, including only successful access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE u.department = 'IT' AND ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count

question: Retrieve all groups created by users from the 'HR' department along with the group names and creation timestamps, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE u.department = 'HR' RETURN DISTINCT g.name, g.created_by

question: Determine the average number of members in groups that were created by users belonging to the 'Finance' department.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE u.department = 'Finance' RETURN AVG(g.member_count) AS avg_member_count

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Pending'. Include the policy effective date and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.effective_date, p.description

question: Determine the average number of resources accessed per user for users who have accessed at least one resource with a sensitivity level of 'Public'. Return the user's name and the average count of resources accessed.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.sensitivity_level = 'Public' RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS public_resource_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae2:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r2:Resource) RETURN u.name, AVG(public_resource_count) AS avg_resources_accessed

question: Find the top 5 departments with the highest average number of access attempts per user, considering only users who have attempted access more than twice.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 2 RETURN u.department, AVG(access_count) AS avg_accesses_per_user ORDER BY avg_accesses_per_user DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 5 most accessed resources by users in the 'Finance' department, including the resource name and the number of accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Finance'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS access_count ORDER BY access_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Return the names of all groups and the number of users in each group who have a role marked as non-compliant. Order the results by the number of non-compliant users in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:false}) RETURN g.name, COUNT(u) AS non_compliant_user_count ORDER BY non_compliant_user_count DESC

question: Retrieve the names of policies that enforce roles granting access to resources of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Pending'. Also, return the associated role names and resource names.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: Find the average number of temporary accesses granted per user for users who have at least one temporary access record, and return the user's name along with this average.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u, COUNT(ta) AS temp_access_count NEXT RETURN u.name, AVG(temp_access_count) AS avg_temp_accesses

question: Identify roles that are associated with users in the 'Finance' department and also enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved', returning the role name and description without duplicates.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role), (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) WHERE u.department = 'Finance' AND p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN DISTINCT r.name, r.description

question: For each resource type, calculate the average number of access events per resource, considering only resources that have been targeted by at least one access event, and order the results by the average in descending order.
gql: MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN r.type, COUNT(ae) / COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS avg_access_events_per_resource ORDER BY avg_access_events_per_resource DESC

question: Retrieve the names of roles that grant access to more than three resources, along with the count of such resources, and order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, count(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN r.name, resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: Find roles that grant access to more than three resources and are enforced by at least two policies. Return the role names and the count of associated resources and policies.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resourceCount NEXT FILTER resourceCount > 3 MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r) RETURN r, resourceCount, COUNT(p) AS policyCount NEXT FILTER policyCount >= 2 RETURN r.name, resourceCount, policyCount

question: Find users who have roles marked as non-compliant and have accessed resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential'. Return the user names, role names, and access outcomes.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = false RETURN u, r NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' RETURN u.name, r.name, ae.outcome

question: Identify roles that are compliant and are enforced by policies reviewed as 'Pending', and return the role names along with the associated resource types they grant access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT r.name, res.type

question: List all groups that contain users who have roles granting them access to resources of type 'Database'. Include the group name and the count of such users in each group, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{type:'Database'}) RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count ORDER BY user_count DESC

question: Retrieve audit logs for actions performed by users who have accessed resources of type 'API Endpoint' more than three times. Include the action, details, and the timestamp of the audit log.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 3 MATCH (al:AuditLog) WHERE al.performed_by = u RETURN al.action, al.details, al.`timestamp`

question: Find all users who have accessed resources of type 'API Endpoint' more than 5 times and belong to groups created by users from the 'IT' department. Return the user names, departments, and the count of their accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(creator:User) WHERE creator.department = 'IT' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS accessCount NEXT FILTER accessCount > 5 RETURN u.name, u.department, accessCount

question: Which departments have users who have roles granting access to both 'Database' and 'Document' type resources? Return the distinct department names.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(resDB:Resource) WHERE resDB.type = 'Database' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:HasRole]->(r2:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(resDoc:Resource) WHERE resDoc.type = 'Document' RETURN DISTINCT u.department

question: Retrieve the top 5 most frequently accessed resources by users not belonging to the 'HR' department, along with the total number of access events for each resource.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE u.department <> 'HR' RETURN r.name, COUNT(ae) AS total_access_events ORDER BY total_access_events DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Restricted', along with the policy name and description.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.sensitivity_level = 'Restricted' RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.description

question: Find groups that have members who have attempted access to resources of type 'API Endpoint'. Return the group names and the count of such members.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS member_count

question: Identify the top 3 roles with the highest number of non-compliant roles that grant access to 'API Endpoint' type resources, returning the role names and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = false AND res.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS api_endpoint_count ORDER BY api_endpoint_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Approved'. Include the policy name, role name, and resource name.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' AND p.review_status = 'Approved' RETURN p.name, r.name, res.name

question: Return the names of policies that enforce at least one role which grants access to a resource of type 'Database', along with the count of such roles per policy.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'Database' RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS role_count

question: Identify the top 3 policies that grant access to the highest number of resources, including the policy name and the count of resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(r:Resource) RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all users who have attempted access to resources but never had a successful outcome, including their department and the count of failed attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE ae.outcome <> 'Success' RETURN u, u.department AS dept, COUNT(ae) AS failed_attempts NEXT RETURN u.name, dept, failed_attempts

question: Identify users who belong to groups created by users from the 'HR' department and have been granted temporary access to at least one resource. Return the user names and the number of temporary accesses.
gql: MATCH (hr_user:User{department:'HR'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess) RETURN u, COUNT(ta) AS temp_access_count NEXT FILTER temp_access_count >= 1 RETURN u.name, temp_access_count

question: Retrieve a list of policies that enforce roles which in turn grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' but are not currently reviewed (review_status is NULL or 'Pending'), including the policy name and its effective date.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'API Endpoint' AND (p.review_status IS NULL OR p.review_status = 'Pending') RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.effective_date

question: Find all users in the 'Engineering' department who have been granted temporary access to resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential', and return their names, the resource names, and the reason for temporary access.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Engineering'})-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(ta:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(r:Resource {sensitivity_level: 'Confidential'}) RETURN u.name, r.name, ta.reason

question: List the number of successful and failed access attempts per user in the 'Marketing' department, including the user's name and the outcome of the access attempt.
gql: MATCH (u:User {department: 'Marketing'})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name, ae.outcome, COUNT(ae) AS attempt_count ORDER BY u.name, ae.outcome

question: Find the number of successful access events per user for resources of type 'File Server', and order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = 'File Server' AND ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS successful_access_count ORDER BY successful_access_count DESC

question: List the groups created by users from the 'IT' department, including the group name, description, and the creator's name. Order the results by the member count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User{department:'IT'})-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) RETURN g.name AS groupName, g.description AS groupDescription, u.name AS creatorName ORDER BY g.member_count DESC

question: List all roles that are compliant and the number of resources each role grants access to, ordered by the number of resources in descending order.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS resource_count ORDER BY resource_count DESC

question: Find the average number of access events per user for users in the 'Marketing' department who have attempted access to resources more than 5 times.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE u.department = 'Marketing' RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 5 RETURN AVG(access_count) AS average_access_events

question: Determine the number of compliant roles that are associated with resources having a sensitivity level of 'Confidential' and were created after January 1, 2023.
gql: MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = true AND res.sensitivity_level = 'Confidential' AND res.created_date > date('2023-01-01') RETURN COUNT(r) AS compliant_role_count

question: For each role, determine how many distinct users hold that role and how many resources it grants access to, listing only roles held by more than 3 users and granting access to more than 5 resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER user_count > 3 AND resource_count > 5 RETURN r.name, user_count, resource_count

question: Retrieve a list of roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and are enforced by more than one policy. Include the role name and the count of enforcing policies.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role) WHERE r.is_compliant = true RETURN r, COUNT(p) AS policy_count NEXT FILTER policy_count > 1 RETURN r.name, policy_count

question: For each group, find the latest access event timestamp involving any of its members. Return the group name and the latest access timestamp.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN g.name, MAX(ae.`timestamp`) AS latest_access_timestamp

question: For each policy that has been reviewed and marked as 'Approved', list the associated roles and the count of distinct resources each role grants access to, but only include roles that grant access to more than two resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, r, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 2 RETURN p.name, r.name, resource_count

question: Identify the top 5 most active users based on the total number of access events they've attempted, including both successful and failed outcomes. Return the user's name and the total count of access events.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS total_access_events ORDER BY total_access_events DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all roles that are compliant and grant access to more than three resources. For each role, provide its name, description, and the count of resources it grants access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role{is_compliant:true})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 RETURN r.name, r.description, resource_count

question: Find the average number of access events per user for users who have attempted access to more than 5 resources, and return the user names along with their average access event count.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS accessCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS resourceCount NEXT FILTER resourceCount > 5 RETURN u.name, AVG(accessCount) AS avgAccessEvents

question: Determine which policies are enforcing roles that have been assigned to users who have temporary access to resources, and return the policy names and role names.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)<-[:HasRole]-(u:User)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:TemporaryAccess)-[:AssignedTempAccess]->(:Resource) RETURN DISTINCT p.name, r.name

question: Identify policies that enforce roles which grant access to more than 3 different resource types, and return the policy names along with the count of distinct resource types.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, COUNT(DISTINCT res.type) AS resource_types_count NEXT FILTER resource_types_count > 3 RETURN p.name, resource_types_count

question: Calculate the total number of access events per department, considering only successful access attempts, and order the results by the total count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE ae.outcome = 'SUCCESS' RETURN u.department, COUNT(ae) AS total_access_events ORDER BY total_access_events DESC

question: List all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and have a review status of 'Approved'. Return the policy name, description, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p.name, p.description, COUNT(res) AS resource_count

question: Identify users who belong to groups with more than 10 members and have attempted access to resources more than 5 times. Return the user's name, department, and the number of access attempts.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`) WHERE g.member_count > 10 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN u, COUNT(ae) AS access_attempts NEXT FILTER access_attempts > 5 RETURN u.name, u.department, access_attempts

question: Retrieve the names of roles that are compliant and are associated with users who have accessed resources from more than 3 different IP addresses. Also, return the count of distinct IP addresses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role{is_compliant:true}), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN r, ae.ip_address AS ip NEXT RETURN r, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS ip_count NEXT FILTER ip_count > 3 RETURN r.name, ip_count

question: Find users who have roles that grant access to more than three resources with a sensitivity level of 'Confidential', and return their names, role names, and the count of such resources.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Confidential'}) RETURN u, r, COUNT(res) AS confidential_resource_count NEXT FILTER confidential_resource_count > 3 RETURN u.name, r.name, confidential_resource_count

question: Retrieve the names of all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint', along with the policy descriptions and the count of such roles.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE res.type = 'API Endpoint' RETURN p.name AS policy_name, p.description AS policy_description, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count

question: Find all users who belong to groups created by users in the 'HR' department and have accessed resources with a sensitivity level of 'Internal' at least once. Return their names and the count of such accesses.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(creator:User) WHERE creator.department = 'HR' RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource{sensitivity_level:'Internal'}) RETURN u.name, COUNT(ae) AS internal_access_count

question: Retrieve the names of users who have roles that grant access to more than 3 resources and have logged at least one audit action, displaying the user name and the count of distinct resources accessed.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:HasRole]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count NEXT FILTER resource_count > 3 MATCH (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(:AccessEvent) RETURN u.name, resource_count

question: Identify resources that have been accessed more than 10 times and are of type 'Database'. Return the resource name, type, and the total number of accesses.
gql: MATCH (r:Resource)<-[:Targets]-(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE r.type = 'Database' RETURN r, COUNT(ae) AS access_count NEXT FILTER access_count > 10 RETURN r.name, r.type, access_count

question: Find all roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and are enforced by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Return the role names and the count of resources each role grants access to.
gql: MATCH (r:Role {is_compliant: true})<-[:Enforces]-(p:Policy {review_status: 'Approved'})-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS resource_count

question: Identify groups that contain users who have attempted access to resources more than 10 times. Return the group name and the average number of access attempts per user in that group.
gql: MATCH (g:`Group`)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) RETURN g, u, COUNT(ae) AS attempt_count NEXT FILTER attempt_count > 10 RETURN g.name, AVG(attempt_count) AS avg_attempts_per_user

question: List policies that enforce roles granting access to resources of type 'Database' and have a review status of 'Pending'. Also include the count of distinct resources affected by these policies.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: 'Pending'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'Database'}) RETURN p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS resource_count

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'API Endpoint' and return the policy names along with the count of such roles, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: 'API Endpoint'}) RETURN p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC

question: For each policy that has been reviewed as 'Approved', determine the number of distinct roles it enforces and the total number of resources these roles grant access to. Return the policy name, the count of roles, and the total number of resources.
gql: MATCH (p:Policy{review_status:'Approved'})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) RETURN p, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS role_count, COUNT(res) AS resource_count NEXT RETURN p.name, role_count, resource_count
